clue.text: Carry drink left on board

parts.note: to sup is to drink in small mouthfuls
port is the left-hand side aboard a ship

explanation.surface: A sailor carries a drink while standing on deck on the left side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on board' belongs with 'left': PORT is the nautical word for left.
explanation.definitionFit: To carry a weight is to bear or hold it up, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Poles initially expecting to be thin on the ground

parts.note: spars are poles, as on a ship

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of expecting is used

explanation.surface: Polish people turn up in smaller numbers than expected.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Poles' suggests people from Poland or the poles N and S; it is SPARS.
explanation.definitionFit: Sparse means scanty or scattered, an idiomatic match for rare and scattered.

clue.text: Ornamental building needing a party space set up

indicators.note: set up in a down clue means raised, so the pieces are read bottom to top

parts.note: a do is a party
a gap is a space

explanation.surface: A decorative pavilion needs room for a party.
explanation.definitionFit: A pagoda is a tiered tower, often used as a decorative garden structure.

clue.text: Got the better of untalked-of criminal

indicators.note: criminal suggests something crooked, so the letters are twisted

explanation.surface: An unknown crook gets the upper hand.
explanation.definitionFit: To outflank is to outmanoeuvre by going round the enemy's side, hence to beat.

clue.text: ID subsumed by rising group trends

indicators.note: subsumed by means absorbed into, so the ID goes within the other word
rising in a down clue means read upwards, so the group word is reversed

parts.note: a set is a group

explanation.surface: Identity swallowed by fashions in an up-and-coming crowd.
explanation.definitionFit: Tides are currents of opinion or movements, so trends.

clue.text: Group importing revolutionary rum fold

indicators.note: importing means bringing something inside, so one piece goes into the other

parts.note: a pack is a group of animals or people

indicators.note: revolutionary suggests turning round, so the synonym of rum is read backwards

parts.note: rum in British slang means odd or strange

explanation.surface: A gang bringing in rebel rum to a sheep fold, like smugglers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rum' is not the drink but an old British adjective meaning strange; 'revolutionary' turns that synonym round before 'importing' puts it in the group word.
explanation.definitionFit: A fold is an enclosure for animals, and a paddock is a fenced field for horses or stock.

clue.text: Article in office journal cut

parts.note: a paper is a newspaper or journal
to clip is to cut

explanation.surface: A clipping from an office newsletter.
explanation.definitionFit: A paperclip is a familiar item of stationery used in offices.

clue.text: Decline work under medical professional

indicators.note: under in a down answer means the work piece is placed after the doctor

parts.note: DR is short for doctor
op is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: A worsening of work done beneath a doctor.
explanation.definitionFit: A drop is a fall or decrease, a synonym for decline.

clue.text: Speaker has one old piece set to music

parts.note: an orator is a public speaker
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A public speaker owns an old tune.
explanation.definitionFit: An oratorio is a large musical work for voices and orchestra on a sacred text.

clue.text: Islands with shade — that's the central point

parts.note: keys are small low islands, as off Florida
a tone is a shade of colour

explanation.surface: Islands in the shadow claim to be the heart of things.
explanation.definitionFit: A keystone is the central stone of an arch, hence the central principle.

clue.text: Language rejected by cryptographer

indicators.note: rejected means thrown back, so the letters are read in reverse
by here means within the word that follows, signalling letters taken from inside it

explanation.surface: A code-breaker turns down a particular tongue.
explanation.walkthrough: TOGRA sits inside 'cryptographer' and turned back gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Argot is the jargon or slang used by a particular group, a kind of language.

clue.text: International relations destabilising Olympic day endlessly

indicators.note: destabilising means throwing into disorder, so the letters are mixed up
endlessly means the last letter of day is dropped

explanation.surface: Diplomatic ties are upset by a never-ending day at the Olympics.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' cuts day to DA; OLYMPIC plus DA is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Diplomacy is the conduct of dealings between states, the business of foreign affairs.

clue.text: Cycling Leeds roads will make you this!

definitions.text: Cycling Leeds roads will make you this

indicators.note: cycling suggests going round and round, so the letters of the two place words are churned into a new order

explanation.surface: A warning that pedalling round Yorkshire's streets leaves you aching.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both definition and wordplay: 'Cycling' is the anagram signal and also the activity that causes the pain.
explanation.definitionFit: Being saddle-sore means chafed and aching from long riding on a bicycle or horse.

clue.text: Run off a quantity of cloth

definitions.meaning: a roll of fabric of a set length

explanation.surface: Someone flees with a roll of fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: One word covers both a sudden escape and a roll of woven material as sold.

clue.text: A person who's followed could be quiet and expert compiler of crosswords

parts.note: P is piano, the musical marking for quiet
an ace is an expert
a setter compiles crosswords

explanation.surface: A setter with a following, both quiet and expert.
explanation.definitionFit: A pacesetter leads and others follow, as a trendsetter or race leader.

clue.text: Establishment play for time beset by independent people

indicators.note: beset by means surrounded by, so the delaying word sits within the word for people

parts.note: a nation is a people
to stall is to delay deliberately

explanation.surface: A stalling tactic surrounded by a free people at some institution.
explanation.definitionFit: An installation is a set-up or facility, such as a military base, so an establishment.

clue.text: Ends trials with men undergoing a change

indicators.note: undergoing a change means altered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Tests on men finish as they are being transformed.
explanation.definitionFit: Terminals are end points, as of a line or a route.

clue.text: Help around new store, like a star

indicators.note: around means the help word surrounds the rearranged letters

parts.note: aid is help

indicators.note: new signals a fresh arrangement of the letters of store

explanation.surface: Assistance arrives at a new shop, celebrity-style.
explanation.walkthrough: 'like a star' is not about fame: the definition is the literal adjective meaning star-shaped.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means star-shaped, from Greek aster, star.

clue.text: Jesting about one's 1 Across on flight

indicators.note: about means the jesting word goes around the other piece

parts.note: banter is playful jesting
one's is read as I'S, the Roman one plus S

explanation.surface: Joking about one's backing on a plane.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flight' means a flight of stairs, not air travel; the definition refers back to 1 Across.
explanation.definitionFit: A banister is the handrail giving a hand-hold along a staircase.

clue.text: Hears about policeman arresting Republican tenant farmer

indicators.note: about means moved around, so the word hears is rearranged
arresting means holding, so the policeman word takes in the party letter

parts.note: copper is informal for a police officer

explanation.surface: A constable detains a Republican and hears the case of a farm tenant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' rearranges HEARS to SHARE; 'arresting' puts R into COPPER.
explanation.definitionFit: A sharecropper farms rented land and pays the owner with part of the crop.

clue.text: Recommendation of a daughter on immorality?

parts.note: vice is immoral behaviour

explanation.surface: Is a daughter being counselled about wickedness?
explanation.definitionFit: Advice is a suggestion about what to do, a recommendation.

clue.text: Rather narrow-minded about head of religion

indicators.note: about means the small-minded word goes around the letter

parts.note: petty means small-minded

indicators.note: head of means the first letter of religion

explanation.surface: Fairly bigoted about the leader of a faith.
explanation.definitionFit: Pretty as an adverb means fairly or somewhat, as in pretty good.

clue.text: Go out and send back couple carrying cross

indicators.note: carrying means holding within, so the reversed word takes the cross inside
send back means return, so the linking word is reversed

parts.note: to tie is to couple or link
X is the shape of a cross

explanation.surface: Leave and return a pair holding a crucifix.
explanation.walkthrough: 'send back' turns TIE into EIT, which then carries X.
explanation.definitionFit: To exit is to leave, a direct synonym of departing.

clue.text: Instigator of heavy metal in bell

indicators.note: in signals one piece placed inside the other

parts.note: a ringer is a bell
lead is a notably heavy metal

explanation.surface: A heavy-metal fan is the troublemaker in the belfry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heavy metal' looks like music but means the element LEAD.
explanation.definitionFit: A ringleader is the person who starts and leads a group in mischief.

clue.text: Talk about Liberal repeatedly causes annoyance

indicators.note: about means the talk word surrounds the doubled letter

parts.note: to gas is to chatter

indicators.note: repeatedly means the Liberal letter appears twice

explanation.surface: Endless chatter about the Liberals is irritating.
explanation.definitionFit: To gall is to vex or irritate, so it brings about irritation.

clue.text: Pay attention to river rising below hospital

indicators.note: below in a down answer means the river comes after the hospital letter

parts.note: H is the map abbreviation for hospital

indicators.note: rising in a down clue means the river is read upwards

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Britain

explanation.surface: Mind the flooding river below the hospital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'below' puts the reversed river after H in a down answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To heed is to listen to and take notice of something.

clue.text: Working dog getting hold of bird without delay

parts.note: on means operating or working

indicators.note: getting hold of means grasping, so the bird goes inside the dog word

parts.note: to tail is to dog or follow someone
a hen is a female bird

explanation.surface: A working dog grabs a bird at once.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dog' is a verb here: to TAIL someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Paying on the nail means paying immediately, an idiom for promptness.

clue.text: Area in shade will be soil

indicators.note: in places the area letter within the colour word

parts.note: a tint is a shade of colour

explanation.surface: Planting a patch of colour will be as good as the earth.
explanation.definitionFit: To taint something is to stain or contaminate it, as soiling does.

clue.text: Ridicules date disheartened with fairground attractions

indicators.note: disheartened means losing the heart, so only the outer letters of date stay

parts.note: rides are fairground amusements

explanation.surface: A miserable date mocks the funfair.
explanation.definitionFit: To deride is to mock or scorn, matching ridicule.

clue.text: Full of regret about church magic

indicators.note: about means around, so the regretful word encloses the church letters

parts.note: sorry means feeling regret
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Remorse over church witchcraft.
explanation.definitionFit: Sorcery is witchcraft or the use of magic powers.
